args.name: Assess an unfamiliar food sample
args.function: Provide a learnable, evidence-producing method to examine a small owned food sample for nutritional usefulness, toxicity, and any preparation required before consumption. Report only what the actual method can establish, with unresolved uncertainties explicit.
args.conditions: I am beside a mature hazelnut plant observed with five units at tick 9. Its visible state did not establish edibility. Berry nutrition 8 and toxicity 0 are known; hazelnut nutrition, toxicity, and preparation needs are unknown. I intend to gather one sample and retain my berries.
args.inputs: An owned food sample; additional tools or materials only if the feasible method requires them and they are actually acquired.
args.costs: Method, time, sample consumption, and equipment costs are unknown. Specify these before use; do not assume laboratory tools or other equipment.
args.effects: Enable actual bounded food-assessment trials with measured findings and stated limits. No automatic knowledge of hidden composition, safety guarantee, health benefit, or mastery from requesting.

candidates.function: Lay whole units of your own berries or roots in one layer on a clean, dry, rigid support to air-dry in actual weather, beside an equal carried untreated reference from the same stack; tend (turn or move), inspect, stop.
candidates.costs: Study: 3 rounds. start: inputStackId, your own unspoiled untreated whole berry or root stack with 2 x quantity whole units (default quantity 1); supportId, your own carried item with quantity whole units that is non-food, non-toxic, non-perishable, dry (water fraction 0.1 or less), rigid (contact-resistance index 8+, flexibility 0), unfractured and clean (no contamination, residue, marking or treatment record), laid on firm ordinary unobstructed ground at x,y (default your position) within 0.65 plus your radius; or an existing food surface in reach, not another person's, of at least 0.04 x quantity area; durationRounds, default 10. One round, 1 energy. tend: within reach of the units; one round, 0.2 energy; turns them in place, or with x,y moves your support and the units to a new ground point in reach. inspect: within reach; reuses probe observe, one round and 0.2 energy. stop: one round, no energy. All checks precede any charge; gathering, travel and pickup cost separately.
candidates.effects: Start separates quantity treated and quantity reference units from the stack with their tenths, decay, harvest time and origin, and gives both the world food water record (assumed water fraction berry 0.85, root 0.75). The treated units lie unowned on the support over 0.04 per unit, the support item held there; the reference stays carried and reserved. Each round the existing rules apply: whole food neither evaporates nor absorbs vapour, so it never dries; rain on an uncovered surface adds 0.01 x rain x area water; decay continues at the ordinary rate where each lies, never reset; nutrition and toxicity are unchanged; contamination is not assessed. Turning changes no represented food state. Inspect records elapsed rounds, quantities, both decays and their difference, visible shrinkage, wetness, spoilage and rain rounds, unverified; water is not measured. After durationRounds the trial ends with a comparison of your recorded readings, or indeterminate without any; spoilage, anyone taking all treated units, stop or death end it early. Ending releases the reference once and leaves the units and support lying at the site for pickup. No preservation, safety, refund or reward.

response.text: {"queries":[],"result_json":"{\"reviews\":[{\"actor\":\"lin\",\"decision\":\"reuse\",\"ability\":\"probe\",\"reason\":\"The searched registry already supplies the smallest feasible precursor: observing and physically testing an owned sample with probe. Its observe, press, wet and heat arguments cover bounded sample examinations without developing a duplicate assessment interface. Neither probe nor the other retrieved capabilities establishes a general nutritional or toxicological assay. Reuse permits evidence-producing examinations with explicit unknowns; it does not promise the requested nutrition, toxicity or preparation conclusions. The sample is already owned at tick 11, so another gathering action is unnecessary.\",\"specification\":\"Reuse probe, equivalence open-baseline:probe:1, handler open.probe, revision foundation-open@1. Its exact arguments are target (string, maximum 360 characters), mode (observe|press|wet|heat), and intensity (number 0 through 1), all required; no additional arguments. Resolve target to an actually visible subject; for destructive food trials additionally require an owned sample. Lin may target item-11-lin-103, the one-unit hazelnut stack originating from start-1-nuts. Do not consume or reserve berry stack item-3-lin-25. The tick-9 plant observation start-1-nuts:observed-state, evidence event-9-lin-84, establishes only its recorded visible state, not edibility. Begin with mode observe: one actual simulation round and 0.2 energy, no sample consumption. Record only externally observable findings supported by the executed interaction. A physical trial costs one round, 0.5 energy and 0.1 actual material unit; require at least that quantity before proceeding and deduct it exactly once. At most ten such deductions can come from the presently owned one-unit sample, absent other losses. A trial portion must be accounted for as changed material, residue or actual consumption/loss, never restored as untouched food. Press may provide only the material responses actually produced and measured; do not promise shell opening, kernel yield or composition. Wet and heat require actual acquired water or an actual heat source and any necessary handling materials, with their availability, quantities, duration and energy requirements resolved before use. None is provided by this approval, and these modes must not execute an effect without its physical cause. Use observe or a physically supported press trial now rather than assume equipment. No ingestion is part of probe. Existing eat, handler forest.eat, separately consumes owned edible food for one energy and applies actual nutrition and toxicity without direct healing; this review does not establish that the hazelnut is edible or authorize a new hazardous tasting mechanism. Report nutrition, toxicity and required preparation as unresolved wherever the performed method cannot establish them. Appearance, pressure response and absence of an immediate visible change cannot prove safety or adequate preparation. Record the target, mode, intensity, time, actual costs, observed response, method limitations and remaining uncertainties, linking any finding to the executed event. Reuse existing probe code and evidence handling explicitly; do not label them reinvention. Probe is one complete interaction with interruption mode cancel, not a persistent research project: retain completed events and incurred costs, cancel unfinished work without a completion finding, and resume only through a newly validated invocation. Death terminates unfinished actor actions; no automatic retry or duplicate refund. Release any surviving unconsumed reservation once; never refund spent energy, elapsed time or destroyed material. No ongoing assessment process or maintenance is created; ordinary item decay continues. Failed prerequisites produce no trial result or material transformation. Established checks and accounting execute in code, not repeated model review. Review waiting advances no world time.\",\"learning\":0,\"experienceReview\":\"Reuse preserves probe's existing zero-round learning duration; Lin must still perform each interaction personally. Requesting, consulting, registration and knowing the capability provide no pleasure, satisfaction or mastery. The current probe contract promises no reward, so this approval adds none. An executed, personally applicable observation or informative failure may be considered only by an existing coded experience rule with functional deduplication, bounded amount and cap, decay and cooldown; repetition of the same non-informative query is not information gain. No protected reward account, budget, goal or permission is changed. No nutrition, health or comfort benefit follows from assessment itself; physical comfort remains capped at 10 and mood never reduces basic nutrition needs.\",\"visualReview\":\"Separate execution evidence from presentation. Reuse the actual interaction event and visual renderer where available, with reusable metadata referencing actor, target, mode, intensity, progress/status, sample quantity change and evidence identifier. Show only an inspection or physical response that occurred. Preserve distinct pending, interrupted, failed and completed states; completed means the interaction completed, not that the food passed a safety test. Nutrition, toxicity and preparation uncertainty must remain visible in the report. Do not show an edible/safe badge, nutritional reading, successful heating or opened shell unless the corresponding observable event supports it. If suitable event or rendering metadata is missing, route that implementation gap into the current development handoff without granting new functional effects or blocking the already supported observation.\"}]}"}
